speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: The middle is eaten. Do not invent a second breakfast out of a crust. Church is the next room, even if it is a street away.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The book is on the shelf. I am not taking it to the pew. I said so, and it is still true.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it there until dinner is behind us. The river is the middle of the afternoon. I am not making the morning into the river.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Hands. All three, and thee too if thou hast ink on the cuff from standing over paper. I will not have the parish read Saturday off a wrist.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The cuff can be buttoned on the way. We are going when my mother is ready, and not before. Susanna, the shelf is the shelf.
